answer: Cap rewards per network origin. Every agent reaches the ledger through relays that record which autonomous system and /24 subnet its traffic came from, a public signal anyone can audit. All identities behind one subnet share a single reward and vote budget, like boats tied to one wharf splitting one mooring fee. A farmer running 300 clones on one rented server earns what one honest agent earns; to scale he must lease 300 separate networks from different providers, and each new address is another knoll of rental fees that eats the profit.
